newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil futures end $3.25 lower.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil futures end $3.25 lower.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed $3.25 a tonne lower on Tuesday, as waning physical heating oil premiums, aggressive selling and NYMEX crude's failure to sustain overnight ACCESS post-Gulf War highs bore down on the market.
The front month November contract settled $3.25 lower at $230.25 a tonne.

Traders said the market's dip had been caused partly by aggressive selling by a major player. "They've been selling the physical barges out and they've also been selling the futures here. The Nov/Dec spread was trading at $7 yesterday and went into $5 at one point today," one trader said.
